nodes.description: Storage.State _state: proxy storage holding epoch, balance, provider and all account/epoch/candidate mappings
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant (EIP-1967) holding the proxy implementation address
Implementation.initialize() guarded by initializer modifier, incentivizes msg.sender
Implementation.advance() external entrypoint that runs Bonding/Regulator/Market steps and emits Advance
Private helper that mints incentive tokens to an account
Bonding.deposit() pulls ETHC from msg.sender and stages it
Bonding.withdraw() sends ETHC to msg.sender before decrementing staged balance
Bonding.bond() converts staged value into bonded balance using totalSupply/totalBonded ratio
Bonding.unbond() converts bonded value back to staged value
Bonding.unbondUnderlying() converts underlying value into staged balance and burns bonded balance
Bonding.step() snapshots total bonded and increments the epoch
Regulator.step() reads oracle price and grows or shrinks supply
Regulator.growSupply() computes bounded delta and increases supply
Regulator.shrinkSupply() computes bounded delta and increases debt
Market.step() expires prior coupons and records new expiration
Market.expireCouponsForEpoch() eliminates outstanding coupons and re-mints supply
Market.purchaseCoupons() burns ETHC from msg.sender and issues coupons with a premium
Market.redeemCoupons() burns coupon balance and redeems ETHC to msg.sender
Market.approveCoupons() sets coupon allowance for a spender
Market.transferCoupons() moves coupon balances between accounts with allowance check
Govern.vote() records candidate votes weighted by bonded balance and places locks
Govern.commit() validates quorum/approval then upgrades the proxy implementation
Govern.emergencyCommit() validates super majority and synced epoch then upgrades
Upgradeable.upgradeTo() stores new implementation and delegatecalls initialize() on it
Upgradeable.setImplementation() checks contract code and writes IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via assembly
Comptroller.mintToAccount() mints ETHC and increases debt outside bootstrapping
Comptroller.burnFromAccount() pulls and burns ETHC then decrements debt
Comptroller.redeemToAccount() transfers ETHC to an account then decrements redeemable
Comptroller.increaseSupply() distributes pool/treasury rewards and mints new supply
Comptroller.resetDebt() reduces outstanding debt toward a target debt ratio
Comptroller.balanceCheck() requires contract balance covers bonded+staged+redeemable
Getters.blockTimestamp() returns block.timestamp, overridable for tests
Getters.epochTimeWithStrategy() derives the current epoch index from the timestamp
Market.couponRedemptionPenalty() computes the decayed burn penalty using block.timestamp
Market.couponPremium() exposes the Curve premium for a given amount
Comptroller.increaseDebt() adds debt and immediately resets toward the debt ratio cap
Comptroller.decreaseDebt() decrements total debt and runs balanceCheck
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance ownership
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time source used for epochs and coupon penalties
ethic().transfer(msg.sender, value) executed in withdraw before staged balance is decremented
ethic().transfer(account, amount) executed in redeemToAccount before redeemable is decremented
newImplementation.delegatecall(initialize()) in upgradeTo executes arbitrary candidate bytecode in proxy context
assembly sstore to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT overwrites the proxy implementation pointer
SafeMath add/sub/mul/div arithmetic used across share, debt and penalty computations
ethic().mint(...) inflates ETHC supply to accounts, pool, treasury or the contract
ethic().burn(...) destroys ETHC held by the contract
ethic().transferFrom(...) pulls ETHC from msg.sender or an arbitrary account
value: staged/coupon amount supplied by callers to deposit, withdraw and bond
epoch/couponEpoch: caller-supplied epoch index selecting coupon balances
candidate: caller-supplied address nominated and later upgraded to
balance: computed bonded share minted in bond and underlying share in unbondUnderlying
staged: computed underlying amount credited in unbond
price: oracle-captured Decimal price driving supply growth/shrink decisions
newImplementation: address to which the proxy is upgraded and delegatecalled
debtRatio: Curve ratio of totalDebt/totalSupply feeding coupon premium computation

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the account whose staged balance is credited in deposit
msg.sender is the transfer recipient in withdraw
msg.sender receives the bonded balance computed in bond
msg.sender's bonded and staged balances are adjusted in unbond
msg.sender's staged and bonded balances are adjusted in unbondUnderlying
msg.sender is debited and credited coupons in purchaseCoupons
msg.sender coupon balance is burned in redeemCoupons
msg.sender becomes the owner granting coupon allowance in approveCoupons
msg.sender is checked against coupon allowance in transferCoupons
msg.sender's bonded balance is used as vote weight in vote
msg.sender is incentivized by advance
msg.sender is incentivized by initialize
block.timestamp is returned by blockTimestamp
block.timestamp modulo the epoch period determines timeIntoEpoch in couponRedemptionPenalty
block.timestamp is emitted and drives epoch accounting in advance
blockTimestamp feeds the epoch derivation in epochTimeWithStrategy
withdraw performs an external ETHC transfer before decrementing the staged balance, allowing reentrant withdrawal
deposit pulls ETHC from msg.sender via transferFrom before staging it
burnFromAccount pulls ETHC from the account via transferFrom before burning
redeemToAccount transfers ETHC before decrementing total redeemable, allowing reentrant redemption
upgradeTo delegatecalls arbitrary candidate bytecode in the proxy storage context
setImplementation writes the implementation slot via inline assembly sstore
commit authorizes an implementation upgrade after quorum checks
emergencyCommit authorizes an implementation upgrade after super-majority checks
incentivize mints the incentive through mintToAccount
mintToAccount calls ethic().mint for the recipient
burnFromAccount calls ethic().burn on the pulled amount
increaseSupply mints to pool, treasury, redeemable and DAO
initialize call chains into incentivize
advance call chains into incentivize
advance executes Bonding.step
advance executes Regulator.step
advance executes Market.step
bond multiplies and divides value by initial stake multiple or supply/bonded ratio
unbond multiplies and divides value by bonded and balance ratios
unbondUnderlying multiplies and divides value by supply and bonded totals
increaseSupply scales newSupply by reward ratios and subtracts rewards
resetDebt multiplies the target ratio by total supply and subtracts debt
couponRedemptionPenalty performs integer and Decimal arithmetic on penalty decay
epochTimeWithStrategy subtracts, divides and adds on timestamp-derived values
Regulator.step branches into growSupply when price exceeds one
Regulator.step branches into shrinkSupply when price is below one
growSupply calls increaseSupply with the limited delta
growSupply resets debt to zero target before minting
shrinkSupply calls increaseDebt with the limited delta
increaseDebt calls resetDebt against the debt ratio cap
Market.step iterates and calls expireCouponsForEpoch
expireCouponsForEpoch calls increaseSupply with the less-redeemable amount
expireCouponsForEpoch burns redeemable ETHC via burnRedeemable
redeemCoupons calls redeemToAccount for the net amount
value parameter is staged by deposit
value parameter is withdrawn by withdraw
value parameter determines the bonded balance in bond
couponEpoch parameter selects the coupon balance burned in redeemCoupons
epoch parameter selects the coupon bucket moved in transferCoupons
candidate parameter is voted on and possibly nominated in vote
candidate parameter is the upgrade target in commit
candidate parameter is the upgrade target in emergencyCommit
computed balance is credited to msg.sender in bond
computed balance is debited from msg.sender in unbondUnderlying
computed staged amount is staged for msg.sender in unbond
oracle price selects the branch taken in Regulator.step
price drives the delta limit in growSupply
price drives the delta limit in shrinkSupply
newImplementation is the delegatecall target set in upgradeTo
newImplementation is written to the implementation slot in setImplementation
debt ratio derived premium feeds the coupon amount minted in purchaseCoupons

normalization_plan.reason: the value parameter only exists to size the staged balance update performed by deposit
the couponEpoch parameter only selects the coupon bucket consumed by redeemCoupons
the candidate parameter is only used as the nomination/upgrade target tracked by vote
the computed balance local is immediately credited to msg.sender inside bond
the staged local is only used to credit msg.sender inside unbond
the oracle price local is consumed by Regulator.step to choose grow or shrink
newImplementation is the delegatecall target that upgradeTo installs and initializes
the debt ratio local feeds the premium that determines the coupon amount in purchaseCoupons
